summary.business_type: Local home-service SAB (plumber, Kansas City / Liberty metro)
top_findings: Duplicate live hosts certproplumbing.com and certproplumbingkc.com with no canonical
Twelve thin service templates (166–187 words including chrome)
NAP split: Chamber cites http://www.certproplumbing.com; site has no hours; GBP unconfirmed
quick_wins: Inject Plumber JSON-LD with telephone and areaServed

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Apex to www on the KC host

findings.title: Two production hosts, no canonical
findings.description: www.certproplumbing.com and www.certproplumbingkc.com both return HTTP 200 with identical homepage byte size (92,889). No rel=canonical on any page.
findings.recommendation: Pick https://www.certproplumbingkc.com, 301 the other host, emit absolute self-canonicals.

findings.title: robots.txt is an HTML 404
findings.description: /robots.txt returns 404 HTML on both hosts, so there is no crawler policy and no sitemap pointer.
findings.recommendation: Add Next.js app/robots.ts allowing / and disallowing /api/.

findings.title: No XML sitemap
findings.description: /sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml 404. Public site: search returned no indexed URLs.
findings.recommendation: Add app/sitemap.ts with 16 indexable URLs; submit in Search Console.

findings.title: Incomplete security headers
findings.description: HSTS present. Missing CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, frame-ancestors, Permissions-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Set headers in Vercel/next.config after host lock.

findings.title: Favicon 404
findings.description: /favicon.ico and /apple-touch-icon.png 404. public/icon.png exists in the repo but is not served at the favicon path.
findings.recommendation: Add app/icon.png or rewrite /favicon.ico to the existing icon.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage has local county coverage and call/book CTAs
Family-owned and licensed claims are consistent in voice

findings.title: Thin duplicate service pages
findings.description: All 12 /services/* pages are 166–187 words including nav/footer (~80–110 unique), sharing the same H2 skeleton and generic FAQs. Coverage floor for service pages is ~800 words.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite Emergency, Sewer, and Water heater first with unique local coverage; then the rest.

findings.title: E-E-A-T: Who/How/Why fail
findings.description: No named plumber or license number on-site. LLC launched May 2026; copy claims thousands of jobs and 30+ years without attributing Derek Drager’s career.
findings.recommendation: Put named bios on /about; attribute prior experience honestly.

findings.title: Decoy insights module
findings.description: Three dated article cards; Read More is a button with no href. View All Articles points at /services. Dates are January 2026, before brand launch.
findings.recommendation: Ship real posts or remove the module.

findings.title: Internal copy in production
findings.description: /services intro says SEO-friendly service pages with reusable conversion sections. Service pages show a Service Template eyebrow.
findings.recommendation: Replace with customer-facing copy.

findings.title: Missing legal pages
findings.description: Privacy and Terms 404; footer links are href=#.
findings.recommendation: Publish Privacy Policy and Terms; wire footer.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique titles on the 12 service leaves

findings.title: Duplicate titles on four core URLs
findings.description: /, /about, /contact, /services all use CertPro Plumbing | Fast Rapid Response North KC Plumbing (56 chars).
findings.recommendation: Per-route generateMetadata.

findings.title: Developer meta description sitewide
findings.description: Mobile-first plumbing website for emergency response… is product copy, 122 chars, reused on core routes. Service descriptions are 54–76 chars and omit geo.
findings.recommendation: 140–160 char intent + geo + CTA snippets.

findings.title: Homepage service cards are not links
findings.description: ServiceGridSection renders six duplicated carousel cards with no Link/href, so the primary services module does not pass PageRank or users to leaf URLs.
findings.recommendation: Wrap each card in Link to /services/[slug].

findings.title: No Open Graph or Twitter tags
findings.description: Zero og:* / twitter:* on crawled pages.
findings.recommendation: Add OG image 1200x630 and per-URL og:url.

findings.title: No JSON-LD on any page
findings.description: 0 ld+json scripts. Missing Plumber/LocalBusiness, Service, BreadcrumbList, WebSite, Person.
findings.recommendation: Server-render a stable @id graph; skip FAQPage for Google SERP (retired 2026-05-07).

findings.title: 9.2 MB autoplay hero video
findings.description: /videos/hero.mp4 is 9,634,384 bytes, autoplay loop on desktop — probable LCP.
findings.recommendation: Compress under ~1.5 MB or use a still; lazy-load video.

findings.title: Oversized photographic PNGs
findings.description: why-choose-vehicle.png is 680 KB; article PNGs 238–384 KB.
findings.recommendation: Convert photos to WebP/AVIF.

findings.title: No field CWV this run
findings.description: PageSpeed Insights API returned 429. PostHog 30-day visitors = 0.
findings.recommendation: Re-run PSI after media fixes; verify analytics capture.

findings.title: Split entity URLs
findings.description: Chamber and email use certproplumbing.com; marketing site is certproplumbingkc.com. AI systems have no single URL to cite.
findings.recommendation: One host + sameAs + citation updates.

findings.title: Low citability of service copy
findings.description: No self-contained 134–167 word answer blocks; no license number or named expert on-page.
findings.recommendation: Front-load a factual entity blurb on Home and About.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Vehicle and article images have descriptive alts
Next/Image is used for several photos

findings.title: Missing favicon and photo-as-PNG weight
findings.description: Favicon 404. Photos shipped as uncompressed PNG. Footer social alts empty with href=#.
findings.recommendation: Add favicon; convert photos; point social to real profiles or remove.

categories.name: Local SEO
what_works: Phone (816) 454-0247 is consistent on-site and on the Chamber listing
Ten-county service area is listed on the homepage

findings.title: Citation and GBP gaps
findings.description: Chamber website is HTTP certproplumbing.com. Site has no hours or street/SAB statement. GBP listing not confirmed in public search.
findings.recommendation: Claim GBP as SAB; publish hours and after-hours policy; align citations.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Remove Service Template / decoy articles / # footer links
About page with named master plumber
Deepen Emergency, Sewer, Water heater pages
Compress hero video and vehicle PNG; add favicon

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Claim and complete GBP as SAB; start review generation
Remaining service pages; optional unique Liberty page

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: GSC indexed count and canonical conflicts
Re-audit after host + schema + three money pages
